sections.heading: Step 1 — Build the Base Skill
sections.body: Complete a minimum of 9 months of hands-on training in your course, working real jobs through your department's production unit.

sections.heading: Step 2 — Get Matched to a Partner
sections.body: PTI identifies an industry or workplace placement suited to your specific course and skill level.

sections.heading: Step 3 — Attach & Apply
sections.body: Work at the partner organisation, applying your training to real tasks under supervision.

sections.heading: Step 4 — Complete & Certify
sections.body: Finish your attachment with a testimonial from the partner organisation, then sit your DIT and UBTEB Trade Test examinations.
